assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_1ec74c143c2ebba.text: Today I want to explain some alternative solutions which may help reduce some of the problems related to climate change.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_1ec74c143c2ebba.zh: 今天我想介绍一些替代方案，它们或许有助于减轻与气候变化相关的一些问题。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_1ec74c143c2ebba.text: The first solution uses solar energy to grow food in the desert.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_1ec74c143c2ebba.zh: 第一个解决方案利用太阳能在沙漠中种植食物。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_1ec74c143c2ebba.text: First of all I'll explain how farming in the desert works.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_1ec74c143c2ebba.zh: 首先，我将说明沙漠农业如何运作。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_1ec74c143c2ebba.text: Then we'll briefly discuss how this type of farming could solve some of the environmental problems we are facing.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_1ec74c143c2ebba.zh: 然后，我们会简要讨论这种农业如何解决我们面临的一些环境问题。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_1ec74c143c2ebba.text: We'll discuss some possible problems with this system.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_1ec74c143c2ebba.zh: 我们将讨论这一系统可能存在的一些问题。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_fef4b955aadf2d4.text: in order to grow plants we need water and sunlight.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_fef4b955aadf2d4.zh: 要种植植物，我们需要水和阳光。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_fef4b955aadf2d4.text: There's a lot of sunlight in the desert,
Scientists have combined solar energy with a farming technology called hydroponics.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_fef4b955aadf2d4.zh: 科学家把太阳能与一种叫作水培的农业技术结合起来。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_fef4b955aadf2d4.text: Hydroponics means growing plants in water.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_fef4b955aadf2d4.zh: 水培法指在水中种植植物。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_fef4b955aadf2d4.text: Plants don't need to grow in the ground,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_fef4b955aadf2d4.zh: 植物不一定要在土壤里生长，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_fef4b955aadf2d4.text: but they do need nutrients to help them grow.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_fef4b955aadf2d4.zh: 但它们确实需要营养物质来生长。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_fef4b955aadf2d4.text: Nutrients are like food for the plants.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_fef4b955aadf2d4.zh: 营养物质就像植物的食物。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7ab619c7055c77c.text: if you add the nutrients to water,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7ab619c7055c77c.zh: 因此，如果把营养物质加入水中，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7ab619c7055c77c.text: you can grow fruit and vegetables in water.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7ab619c7055c77c.zh: 你就可以在水中种植水果和蔬菜。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7ab619c7055c77c.text: NASA scientists have been developing this method of growing food because it could allow us to grow food in any climate – in Antarctica,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7ab619c7055c77c.zh: 美国宇航局的科学家一直在研发这种种植方法，因为它可以让我们在任何气候下种植食物——在南极洲，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7ab619c7055c77c.text: You might ask how this method of growing plants helps with the problem of climate change.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7ab619c7055c77c.zh: 你可能会问，这种植物种植方法如何有助于解决气候变化问题。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7ab619c7055c77c.text: I mean, after all it uses fresh water, which is a limited resource.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7ab619c7055c77c.zh: 我的意思是，毕竟它要用淡水，而淡水是有限资源。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_bb2db4584201a81.text: A line of mirrors reflects heat from the sun onto a pipe which has oil inside.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_bb2db4584201a81.zh: 一排镜子把太阳的热量反射到一根内部装有油的管道上。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_bb2db4584201a81.text: The hot oil in the pipe heats up seawater,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_bb2db4584201a81.zh: 管道里的热油给海水加热，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_bb2db4584201a81.text: which is kept in special containers.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_bb2db4584201a81.zh: 海水被储存在特殊容器中。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_bb2db4584201a81.text: When the seawater reaches 160 degrees Celsius,

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_9e722cbc9b9ca03.text: Some of the hot water is used to heat the greenhouse during the cold desert nights.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_9e722cbc9b9ca03.zh: 一部分热水被用来在寒冷的沙漠夜晚给温室加热。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_9e722cbc9b9ca03.text: The plants grow in the greenhouse,
a building with glass walls and a glass ceiling.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_9e722cbc9b9ca03.zh: 温室是一种有玻璃墙和玻璃顶的建筑。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_9e722cbc9b9ca03.text: The rest of the heated water goes to a desalination plant.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_9e722cbc9b9ca03.zh: 其余加热后的水会进入海水淡化厂。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_9e722cbc9b9ca03.text: Desalination is when we remove the salt from seawater to create drinkable water.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_9e722cbc9b9ca03.zh: 海水淡化是指从海水中去除盐分，制成可饮用的水。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_9e722cbc9b9ca03.text: That is water which is clean and safe to drink.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_9e722cbc9b9ca03.zh: 这种水既干净又可以安全饮用。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_bc5ceef481d9052.text: The desalination plant can produce up to ten ,000 litres of fresh water every day.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_bc5ceef481d9052.zh: 海水淡化厂每天最多可生产1万升淡水。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_bc5ceef481d9052.text: The farmer adds nutrients to this fresh water and then grows fruit and vegetables.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_bc5ceef481d9052.zh: 农民向这些淡水中加入养分，然后种植水果和蔬菜。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_bc5ceef481d9052.text: solar energy removes the salt from the seawater and the fresh water is then used inside the greenhouse where the plants are growing.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_bc5ceef481d9052.zh: 总之，太阳能去除海水中的盐分，得到的淡水随后在种植植物的温室中使用。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_ba00d9f2bddee0b.text: Many people around the world are really excited about this technology.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_ba00d9f2bddee0b.zh: 全世界许多人都对这项技术感到非常兴奋。
到目前为止，澳大利亚农场已经种植了番茄，
辣椒和黄瓜，采用的是水培技术。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_ba00d9f2bddee0b.text: Many supermarkets are interested in buying these vegetables because they are grown without pesticides or other chemicals.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_ba00d9f2bddee0b.zh: 许多超市有意购买这些蔬菜，因为它们种植时没有使用农药或其他化学物质。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_ba00d9f2bddee0b.text: Some people think hydroponics is the perfect solution to the world food crisis.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_ba00d9f2bddee0b.zh: 有些人认为水培法是解决世界粮食危机的完美办法。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_f2b94cf7d4fc12d.text: the desert farms use solar energy and not fossil fuels.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_f2b94cf7d4fc12d.zh: 最后，沙漠农场使用太阳能，而不是化石燃料。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_f2b94cf7d4fc12d.text: Thus, their negative effect on the environment is minimal.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_f2b94cf7d4fc12d.zh: 因此，它们对环境的负面影响极小。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_f2b94cf7d4fc12d.text: the future of hydroponics is unknown.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_f2b94cf7d4fc12d.zh: 水培技术的未来尚不明朗。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_f2b94cf7d4fc12d.text: But I think the desert farms might be a very interesting way to farm in the future.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_f2b94cf7d4fc12d.zh: 但我认为，沙漠农场可能会成为未来一种很有前景的耕作方式。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_f2b94cf7d4fc12d.text: Now, let's discuss some of the problems.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_f2b94cf7d4fc12d.zh: 现在，我们来讨论一些问题。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_3fd6d550eea0dd1.zh: 将水培技术与太阳能结合起来。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_3fd6d550eea0dd1.text: Traditional farming uses between 60 and 80 % of our planet's fresh water.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_3fd6d550eea0dd1.zh: 传统农业消耗地球淡水资源的60%到80%。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_3fd6d550eea0dd1.text: Sun Drop Farms doesn't use fresh water.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_3fd6d550eea0dd1.zh: 然而，阳光农场不使用淡水。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_3fd6d550eea0dd1.text: Sun Drop Farms is only 100 metres from the shore.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_3fd6d550eea0dd1.zh: 阳光农场距离海岸只有100米。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7ef22b781d17a4e.text: A line of mirrors reflects heat from the sun onto a pipe which has oil inside.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7ef22b781d17a4e.zh: 一排镜子把太阳的热量反射到一根内部装有油的管道上。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7ef22b781d17a4e.text: The hot oil in the pipe heats up seawater,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7ef22b781d17a4e.zh: 管道里的热油给海水加热，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7ef22b781d17a4e.text: which is kept in special containers.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7ef22b781d17a4e.zh: 海水被储存在特殊容器中。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7ef22b781d17a4e.text: When the seawater reaches 160 degrees Celsius,
Some of the hot water is used to heat the greenhouse during the cold desert nights.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7ef22b781d17a4e.zh: 一部分热水被用来在寒冷的沙漠夜晚给温室加热。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7ef22b781d17a4e.text: The plants grow in the greenhouse,
a building with glass walls and a glass ceiling.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7ef22b781d17a4e.zh: 温室是一种有玻璃墙和玻璃顶的建筑。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7ef22b781d17a4e.text: The rest of the heated water goes to a desalination plant.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7ef22b781d17a4e.zh: 其余加热后的水会进入海水淡化厂。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7ef22b781d17a4e.text: Desalination is when we remove the salt from seawater to create drinkable water.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7ef22b781d17a4e.zh: 海水淡化是指从海水中去除盐分，制成可饮用的水。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7ef22b781d17a4e.text: That is water which is clean and safe to drink.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7ef22b781d17a4e.zh: 这种水既干净又可以安全饮用。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2aefa8e628019a2.text: Welcome to today's debate on the advantages and disadvantages of nuclear energy.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2aefa8e628019a2.zh: 欢迎参加今天关于核能利弊的辩论。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2aefa8e628019a2.text: Some people think that nuclear power is an environmentally friendly source of energy because it creates less pollution than traditional power plants.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2aefa8e628019a2.zh: 有些人认为核能是一种环保能源，因为它比传统发电厂产生的污染更少。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2aefa8e628019a2.text: However,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2aefa8e628019a2.zh: 不过，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2aefa8e628019a2.text: the opponents of nuclear energy believe that it has more dangers than benefits.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2aefa8e628019a2.zh: 然而，核能的反对者认为它的危险大于好处。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2aefa8e628019a2.text: Debating this issue today are Emma Martinez and Jack Sullivan.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2aefa8e628019a2.zh: 今天参与辩论的是埃玛·马丁内斯和杰克·沙利文。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2aefa8e628019a2.text: Thank you for joining us today to share your opinions about this important issue.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2aefa8e628019a2.zh: 感谢你们今天加入我们，分享对这个重要议题的看法。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2aefa8e628019a2.text: Thank you.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2aefa8e628019a2.zh: 谢谢。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2aefa8e628019a2.text: I want to argue that there are many problems with nuclear power.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2aefa8e628019a2.zh: 我想论证核电存在许多问题。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2aefa8e628019a2.text: It may be true that there are very few accidents caused by nuclear plants, but if there is an accident, then it will be huge and it will have long -term effects on the environment.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2aefa8e628019a2.zh: 核电站造成的事故或许很少，但一旦发生事故，影响就会非常严重且长期危害环境。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2aefa8e628019a2.text: For example,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2aefa8e628019a2.zh: 例如，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2aefa8e628019a2.text: after the Fukushima nuclear disaster in Japan, the government had to tell people to leave their homes because of the possibility of radiation.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2aefa8e628019a2.zh: 例如，日本福岛核事故后，由于可能受到辐射，政府不得不要求人们离开家园。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2aefa8e628019a2.text: The radioactive material spread to water and food, such as tea,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2aefa8e628019a2.zh: 放射性物质扩散到水和食物中，例如茶，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2aefa8e628019a2.text: milk,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2aefa8e628019a2.zh: 牛奶，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2aefa8e628019a2.text: beef,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2aefa8e628019a2.zh: 牛肉，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2aefa8e628019a2.text: and fish.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2aefa8e628019a2.zh: 以及鱼类。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2aefa8e628019a2.text: For months after the accident, the Fukushima plant was dangerous.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2aefa8e628019a2.zh: 事故发生后的几个月里，福岛核电站都很危险。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2aefa8e628019a2.text: People will not be able to live in the nearby area for the next 20 years.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2aefa8e628019a2.zh: 未来20年，人们将无法在附近地区居住。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2aefa8e628019a2.text: This is the big risk of building a nuclear power plant.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2aefa8e628019a2.zh: 这就是建设核电站的重大风险。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2aefa8e628019a2.text: In my opinion,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2aefa8e628019a2.zh: 在我看来，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2aefa8e628019a2.text: it's irresponsible for governments to allow nuclear power plants to be built near cities.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2aefa8e628019a2.zh: 在我看来，允许在城市附近建设核电站是政府不负责任的行为。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2aefa8e628019a2.text: They're just too dangerous.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2aefa8e628019a2.zh: 它们实在太危险了。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2aefa8e628019a2.text: I have to disagree.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2aefa8e628019a2.zh: 我必须不同意。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2aefa8e628019a2.text: I think we should look at the bigger picture.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2aefa8e628019a2.zh: 我认为我们应该从更大的角度看问题。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2aefa8e628019a2.text: Some people are worried that nuclear power is a big risk.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2aefa8e628019a2.zh: 有些人担心核电是一个很大的风险。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2aefa8e628019a2.text: And yet,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2aefa8e628019a2.zh: 然而，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2aefa8e628019a2.text: there are hundreds of nuclear power plants all over the world, and there have only been three major nuclear accidents in the last 30 years.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2aefa8e628019a2.zh: 世界各地有数百座核电站，而过去30年中仅发生过三起重大核事故。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2aefa8e628019a2.text: In fact,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2aefa8e628019a2.zh: 事实上，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2aefa8e628019a2.text: research shows that many more people die while working with coal,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2aefa8e628019a2.zh: 事实上，研究表明，与煤炭打交道时死亡的人数更多，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2aefa8e628019a2.text: natural gas,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2aefa8e628019a2.zh: 天然气，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2aefa8e628019a2.text: and hydropower,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2aefa8e628019a2.zh: 以及水力发电，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2aefa8e628019a2.text: that is,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2aefa8e628019a2.zh: 也就是说，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2aefa8e628019a2.text: electricity powered by water.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2aefa8e628019a2.zh: 即用水来发电。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2aefa8e628019a2.text: On top of that,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2aefa8e628019a2.zh: 此外，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2aefa8e628019a2.text: nuclear power is the most environmentally friendly and the most sustainable source of energy.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2aefa8e628019a2.zh: 核能是最环保、最可持续的能源。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2aefa8e628019a2.text: In other words,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2aefa8e628019a2.zh: 换句话说，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2aefa8e628019a2.text: it doesn't damage the environment,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2aefa8e628019a2.zh: 换句话说，它不会破坏环境，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2aefa8e628019a2.text: and there will always be enough of it.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2aefa8e628019a2.zh: 而且永远不会耗尽。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2ea31df31826f17.text: A nuclear power plant does not pollute the air,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2ea31df31826f17.zh: 核电站不会污染空气，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2ea31df31826f17.text: it's relatively cheap,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2ea31df31826f17.zh: 它的成本相对较低，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2ea31df31826f17.text: and it can provide a huge amount of electricity to our cities.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2ea31df31826f17.zh: 还能为城市提供大量电力。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2ea31df31826f17.text: And of course,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2ea31df31826f17.zh: 当然，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2ea31df31826f17.text: our cities are growing.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2ea31df31826f17.zh: 我们的城市正在发展。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2ea31df31826f17.text: I'm sorry, can I interrupt?
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2ea31df31826f17.zh: 抱歉，我能打断一下吗？

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2ea31df31826f17.text: Some people say that nuclear energy doesn't pollute the air, but that's not completely true.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2ea31df31826f17.zh: 有人说核能不会污染空气，但这并不完全正确。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2ea31df31826f17.text: It takes many years to build a nuclear power plant.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2ea31df31826f17.zh: 建造一座核电站需要很多年。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2ea31df31826f17.text: During this time,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2ea31df31826f17.zh: 在此期间，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2ea31df31826f17.text: hundreds of machines work day and night and pollute the air in the area.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2ea31df31826f17.zh: 数百台机器日夜运转，污染当地空气。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2ea31df31826f17.text: I don't think it's necessary to build nuclear power plants when we have safer and more environmentally friendly energy sources, such as solar and wind energy.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2ea31df31826f17.zh: 当我们拥有太阳能和风能等更安全、更环保的能源时，我认为没有必要建核电站。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2ea31df31826f17.text: They're cheaper,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2ea31df31826f17.zh: 它们更便宜，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2ea31df31826f17.text: and they're unlimited sources of energy.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2ea31df31826f17.zh: 而且是取之不尽的能源。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2ea31df31826f17.text: Also, they're more affordable for most countries when compared with nuclear power.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2ea31df31826f17.zh: 与核能相比，它们对大多数国家也更负担得起。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2ea31df31826f17.text: Building a nuclear power plant is not a solution for low -income countries.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2ea31df31826f17.zh: 建设核电站并不是低收入国家的解决办法。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2ea31df31826f17.text: I'm not sure about that.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2ea31df31826f17.zh: 我不太确定。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2ea31df31826f17.text: I think that building nuclear power plants is the perfect solution for many low -income countries.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2ea31df31826f17.zh: 我认为建设核电站正是许多低收入国家的理想解决方案。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2ea31df31826f17.text: Yes, it might be expensive to build the plant, but once the nuclear plant is there, the cost of the production of energy is very low.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2ea31df31826f17.zh: 没错，建造核电站可能很昂贵，但一旦核电站建成，生产能源的成本就很低。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2ea31df31826f17.text: Plus,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2ea31df31826f17.zh: 此外，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2ea31df31826f17.text: the country can sell the electricity to its neighbors and improve its economy.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2ea31df31826f17.zh: 国家可以向邻国出售电力，改善经济。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2ea31df31826f17.text: It's a long -term solution,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2ea31df31826f17.zh: 这是一项长期方案，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2ea31df31826f17.text: and it makes a country less dependent on oil and gas.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2ea31df31826f17.zh: 它也使国家更少依赖石油和天然气。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2ea31df31826f17.text: At the moment,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2ea31df31826f17.zh: 目前，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2ea31df31826f17.text: whenever oil or gas prices go up,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2ea31df31826f17.zh: 每当石油或天然气价格上涨时，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2ea31df31826f17.text: it's low -income countries and the people who live in them that suffer.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2ea31df31826f17.zh: 受苦的都是低收入国家及其人民。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2ea31df31826f17.text: Some people think that solar and wind energy are greener than nuclear energy,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2ea31df31826f17.zh: 有些人认为太阳能和风能比核能更环保，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2ea31df31826f17.text: but I don't think that's accurate.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2ea31df31826f17.zh: 但我认为这并不准确。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2ea31df31826f17.text: Wind turbines are not exactly friendly for birds,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2ea31df31826f17.zh: 风力涡轮机对鸟类并不友好，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2ea31df31826f17.text: not to mention that solar panels and wind turbines take up a lot of space.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2ea31df31826f17.zh: 更不用说太阳能板和风力涡轮机占用大量空间。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2ea31df31826f17.text: They're also very expensive and don't last as long as a nuclear power plant.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2ea31df31826f17.zh: 它们也非常昂贵，而且使用寿命不如核电站长。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2ea31df31826f17.text: In short,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2ea31df31826f17.zh: 总之，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2ea31df31826f17.text: wind and solar energy can't solve the problem of climate change,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2ea31df31826f17.zh: 总之，风能和太阳能无法解决气候变化问题，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2ea31df31826f17.text: and they aren't a good solution for low -income countries.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2ea31df31826f17.zh: 也不是低收入国家的好方案。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2ea31df31826f17.text: Thank you both very much.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2ea31df31826f17.zh: 非常感谢两位。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2ea31df31826f17.text: Let's take some questions from the audience.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2ea31df31826f17.zh: 下面请观众提问。
